messages:
liz: quick sync — we need to finalize acceptance for chat/completions + rerank launch
omar: +1. agenda: scope, canary, metrics, edge cases
liz: customer-driven asks: deterministic rerank flag, configurable top_k, and per-request candidate score breakdown in response
kevin: draft acceptance criteria:
- API surface: `POST /v1/rerank` supports `candidates` + `context` parity with embeddings format
- default `top_k` = 5, max allowed = 100
- optional `deterministic: true|false` with `seed` param when true
- response must include `rerank_scores` array same length as candidates
- perf: 95p latency <= 120ms for candidate_count <= 10 on hosted small model profile
- quality: MRR@5 no worse than baseline model by >5% on internal eval set
sarah: edge cases to call out in PRD: empty candidates -> 400; mismatched candidates/context encoding -> 422; candidates > max -> 413 with helpful error; very long context -> truncate and emit warning header `X-Context-Truncated: 1`
liz: operational ACs: canary rollout (10% keys) -> require automated fallback to legacy rerank endpoint if error rate > 2% or latency > 250ms for 5m window
omar: rollout metrics we should track: 95p latency, p99, error rate, MRR@5, token cost delta, CPU/GPU utilization; create dashboards in Console pre-launch
kevin: perf test checklist: add `scripts/load_test_rerank.sh` for candidate sizes 5/20/50; run at 1k qps sustained for 5m on dedicated to validate autoscale rules
sarah: acceptance tests: unit + integration + two adversarial cases (all identical candidates, and maliciously long candidate strings) + end-to-end quality regression against canary eval set
liz: spec note: deterministic rerank influences caching and batching. if `deterministic=true` we must bypass KV cache for that request or ensure seeding is fully reproducible across batched execution — doc this as a limitations section
omar: tradeoff: enabling determinism will raise latency variance. recommend opt-in default = false, and quota-bound on Hosted (e.g., deterministic requests count against a special billable metric)
kevin: API contract detail: include `X-Model-Variant` in response headers for observability; `rerank_scores` floats normalized 0..1; schema example in PRD snippet:
```json
{
  "candidates": ["A","B","C"],
  "rerank_scores": [0.82,0.12,0.06]
}
```
product-bot: deploy scheduled to staging at 1765128000; reminder: run perf harness post-deploy
liz: I'll update the PRD with these ACs, add the edge-case table, and push an RFC diff to the `redwood/api-rerank` PR. pinging for signoff: @kevin @omar please confirm perf ownership; @sarah confirm test cases
kevin: confirmed. I'll own perf runs and add scripts to `eng-runtime` repo
omar: confirmed. I'll wire dashboards and canary policy in Console
sarah: tests added to my board, will add the adversarial inputs
liz: thanks all — aiming to freeze scope by EOD Friday. :thumbsup:
